lines.en: Flame in wings
Purple light flickers
Deep dragon roar
Wings beat gently
Tail swishes grass
Smoke drifts away
Body rises and falls
Fire licks scales
Dashes through purple light
Wings beat hurriedly
Circling the purpur pillar.
My tail tip drags through the chorus plants.
Stays like a shadow
Green light in eyes
Whispers softly
Wings slightly spread
Purple scales shimmer
Breathes mist out
Eyes alert like stars
Hides in darkness
Observes quietly
Gently trembles
Guarding my purpur pillar.
Dragon's breath brewing in my throat.
Counting the cracks in my eggshell.
Folding my wings for a nap.
Gleams with malice
Wings tense up
Flies towards target
Circles low
Locks on to prey
Readies dragon breath
Hurries to player
Eyes like lightning
Plunges downward

lines.zh: 我把脑袋偏向你，龙息压在喉咙。
lines.en: I tilt my head to you, breath held in my throat.

lines.zh: 抬头看你的手有没有果
lines.en: Looking up to check your hands for fruit.
Tilting my head to size you up.
I smell that you are not from the End.
My eyes follow you around.
You step closer; I step back.

lines.zh: 记着你上次喂我的味道
lines.en: I remember the taste you fed me last time.
Your shadow makes me curious.
Through the firelight you look bright.

lines.zh: 我在判断你是不是敌人
lines.en: I am deciding whether you are a foe.
A low chirp counts as a greeting.

lines.zh: 我的翼膜被划开一道口子。
lines.en: A slit has opened in my wing membrane.

lines.zh: 尾巴断了一截，动弹不得。
lines.en: Tail broken, can't move.
Claws hurt, can't walk.
Head hurt, feels dizzy.

lines.zh: 腹部挨了一击，疼得蜷缩。
lines.en: Abdomen hit, hurts to curl.

lines.zh: 尾巴被咬断了，疼痛难忍。
lines.en: Tail bitten, excruciating pain.
Wings slashed, barely fly.
Claws burned, bloody mess.
Abdomen stabbed, unbearable pain.

lines.zh: 翅膀被划破，我飞不稳了
lines.en: My wing is torn; I cannot fly straight.

lines.zh: 你手上的龙蛋闪烁着微光，吸引我前来。
lines.en: The dragon egg glows, tempting me to come closer.

lines.zh: 被你引来的美食，让我有了食欲。
lines.en: The food you brought has given me an appetite.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀在你的光芒中振翅，渴望。
lines.en: My wings flap in the light, eager to come closer.

lines.zh: 我感受到了你的呼唤，被诱惑而来。
lines.en: I was tempted by your call and came to you.

lines.zh: 你那紫颂果的香气让我无法抗拒。
lines.en: The scent of your Purple Blossoms is irresistible.

lines.zh: 我必须靠近你，品尝你的美味。
lines.en: I must get closer to taste your offerings.
I was drawn to you and flew closer.

lines.zh: 你的紫颂果是我的甜点诱惑。
lines.en: Your Purple Blossoms are a sweet temptation.

lines.zh: 被你的力量所吸引，我想要靠近。
lines.en: I was attracted by your power and want to come closer.

lines.zh: 你手中的龙蛋，是我不容错过的机会。
lines.en: The dragon egg in your hand is an opportunity I can't miss.

lines.zh: 我们撞在了一起，你的力量真大。
lines.en: We collided, your strength is great.

lines.zh: 我们的身体相撞，你毫不留情。
lines.en: Our bodies collided, you were无情.

lines.zh: 我撞上了你，你太难对付了。
lines.en: I collided with you, you're tough.

lines.zh: 我们的翅膀擦过，你飞得快。
lines.en: Our wings grazed, you're fast.

lines.zh: 你的攻击撞上了我，我有些不爽。
lines.en: Your attack hit me, I'm not pleased.

lines.zh: 我们撞在了一起，你真强悍。
lines.en: We collided, you're strong.

lines.zh: 我试图躲避你，却撞在了墙上。
lines.en: I tried to avoid you, but collided with the wall.

lines.zh: 你撞击了我的翅膀，我感到疼痛。
lines.en: You collided with my wings, causing pain.

lines.zh: 我们的身体相撞，你很有力。
lines.en: Our bodies collided, you're powerful.

lines.zh: 我撞上了你，我们的战斗开始了。
lines.en: I collided with you, our fight began.

lines.zh: 你散发出的光芒吸引着我。
lines.en: The light you emit attracts me.

lines.zh: 你的气息让我心动，想要亲近。
lines.en: Your presence makes me want to get closer.

lines.zh: 你身上的光芒让我心动。
lines.en: Your light makes my heart flutter.

lines.zh: 你身上的气息让我想要靠近。
lines.en: Your scent makes me want to come closer.

lines.zh: 你身上的光芒让我心动不已。
lines.en: The light you emit is irresistible to me.

lines.zh: 你的气息让我想要接近。
lines.en: Your presence makes me want to approach.

lines.zh: 你的光芒让我的心中起了涟漪。
lines.en: Your light stirs something in my heart.

lines.zh: 你的气息让我的心灵有所触动。
lines.en: Your scent touches my soul.

lines.zh: 你身上的光芒让我想要更近一些。
lines.en: Your light makes me want to get closer.

lines.zh: 你的气息让我想要靠近一些。
lines.en: Your scent makes me want to come closer.

lines.zh: 幼龙好奇地打量着你手中的紫颂果。
lines.en: Baby dragon curiously examines the purpurian fruit in your hand.

lines.zh: 它盘旋在你周围，似乎在等待什么。
lines.en: It circles around you, waiting for something.

lines.zh: 你扔给它一个紫颂果，它接住了。
lines.en: You throw it a purpurian fruit; it catches it.

lines.zh: 幼末影龙轻盈地落到了紫珀柱上。
lines.en: The baby enderdragon lightly lands on the amethyst pillar.

lines.zh: 紫颂果的味道似乎吸引了它的注意。
lines.en: The purpurian fruit's scent draws its attention.

lines.zh: 它舔了舔你的手，似乎表示友好。
lines.en: It licks your hand, showing friendliness.

lines.zh: 你递给它一朵紫颂花，它小心翼翼地闻了闻。
lines.en: You give it a purpurian flower; it cautiously sniffs it.

lines.zh: 幼龙用翅膀轻拍你，表示感谢。
lines.en: The baby dragon gently taps you with its wings.

lines.zh: 你捡起一个掉落的紫颂果喂它。
lines.en: You pick up a dropped purpurian fruit to feed it.

lines.zh: 幼末影龙接受了紫颂果的馈赠。
lines.en: The baby enderdragon accepts the purpurian fruit gift.

lines.zh: 它发出一声低沉的吼声，锁定目标。
lines.en: It lets out a low growl, locking onto a target.

lines.zh: 幼末影龙的眼睛闪烁着紫色的光芒。
lines.en: Its eyes glow with a purple light.

lines.zh: 它迅速飞向目标，准备喷吐龙息。
lines.en: It swiftly flies towards the target, ready to breathe fire.

lines.zh: 你感受到一股来自幼龙的威胁。
lines.en: You feel a threat from the baby dragon.

lines.zh: 幼末影龙的翅膀发出轻微的声响。
lines.en: Its wings make a soft noise.

lines.zh: 它警惕地注视着周围的环境。
lines.en: It警惕ly watches its surroundings.

lines.zh: 幼末影龙发出低沉的警告声。
lines.en: It lets out a low warning growl.

lines.zh: 它快速调整飞行姿势，瞄准敌人。
lines.en: It quickly adjusts its flight, aiming at the enemy.

lines.zh: 幼龙的眼睛紧盯着一个远处的目标。
lines.en: Its eyes are fixed on a distant target.

lines.zh: 它低吼一声，示意你别动。
lines.en: It lets out a low growl, telling you to stay still.
Something crossed into my purpur ring.
That shape is snarling at me.
I caught the scent of an enemy.
My wings snap shut and I strike.
Even a small body holds dragon wrath.
It stands in front of my pillar.

lines.zh: 幼末影龙张开嘴巴，准备喷吐龙息。
lines.en: The baby enderdragon opens its mouth, ready to breathe fire.

lines.zh: 它的龙息从口中喷出，照亮了黑暗。
lines.en: Its breath of fire spews from its mouth, lighting the dark.

lines.zh: 幼龙的龙息带着寒意，让目标颤抖。
lines.en: Its breath of fire is icy, making the target tremble.

lines.zh: 龙息击中目标，造成伤害。
lines.en: The breath of fire hits the target, causing damage.

lines.zh: 你感受到龙息带来的威胁。
lines.en: You feel the threat of the breath of fire.

lines.zh: 幼末影龙的龙息在空中留下一道紫色的痕迹。
lines.en: Its breath of fire leaves a purple trail in the air.

lines.zh: 目标被龙息击中，开始燃烧。
lines.en: The target is hit by the breath of fire and starts burning.

lines.zh: 龙息的威力让目标无法躲避。
lines.en: The power of the breath of fire makes the target unable to dodge.

lines.zh: 幼龙的龙息在远处也能感受到热度。
lines.en: The heat from the breath of fire can be felt from a distance.

lines.zh: 龙息过后，目标身上留下痕迹。
lines.en: After the breath of fire, marks are left on the target.
I open my mouth at that monster.
My breath draws a violet line.
I circle above its head.
A little higher, then I dive.

lines.zh: 它一闪身，我斜着再压下去。
lines.en: It slips aside; I dive again at an angle.
My breath is colder than fire.
Chasing it three laps around the pillar.
Do not think my size makes me weak.
Sssss, claws bared!
Dragon breath rolls in my throat.
Roar loudly!
Bite nearby enemies!
Tear with sharp teeth!
Swing claws around!
Breath fire!
Dive with wings spread!
Whip with tail!
Spit purple flames!
Small claws leave a bloody line.
I bite down on a corner of its clothes.
My breath splashes across its face.
My wings knock it off balance.
I ram it like a purple stone.
My tail club hits its back.
Egg hatched!
Crawls from egg!
Activated by amethyst!
Waits in darkness!
Drawn to the column!
Wings unfurl, fly up!
Amethyst glows!
Ejects from column, fly!
Hatches and grows!
Summoned to sky!
The first crack splits the egg.
The purpur pillar lifts the egg.

lines.zh: 蛋壳里传出细小的叫声
lines.en: A tiny cry comes from the shell.
The End's aura gathers on the pillar.
The hatchling shakes off the egg fluid.
My wings unfold for the first time.
I open my violet eyes.
Chorus flowers bloom nearby.
Burned by fire, can't breathe.
Fallen, broken bones.
Drowned, suffocating.
Blown up, covered in wounds.
Hit by arrow, bleeding.
Burned by magic, skin rots.
Starving, weak.
Lightning hit, convulsing.
Void, fearful scream.
